publication_note: Editorial finalization only; no new experiments or peer review. Historical measurements and deployment evidence are unchanged.

controls.scope: selected flat-background recolor controls, not general accuracy

lifecycle_comic_pair.scope: private synthetic two-panel request (one circle); delivery mechanics only
lifecycle_comic_pair.direct_review: both pages: one complete circle moving left to right; choice 2 second circle ~7% wider

eight_panel_comic_pair.scope: private production Discord request combining ordered binary-cartoon and colour-photographic references into an 8 to 12 panel comic
eight_panel_comic_pair.prompt: !kraken can you combine these two images into a 8 to 12 panel comic?

binary_ink_calibration.scope: labelled binary-ink vs hatched/grey-wash cells from this storyline

eight_panel_comic_pair.direct_review: both pages: exact 8-panel wordless binary-ink grids preserving source order (Panel 1 cartoon mouse at wheel, Panel 2 illustrated human with rocket, Panels 3-8 shared rocket drop-and-catch arc); human facial/suit contours use finer interior strokes than solid cel fills, and ship's wheel size/position shifts across cells

accessory_study.scope: seven private requests; small selected set, not an accuracy estimate
accessory_study.rule: enable bounded additions only if no gate-passing bounded output is wrong on direct review and the bounded lane is correct at least as often as the whole-image path
